text:
The Thessaly Weir diverts the Callan, and the arrangement became official on 14 March 2019.

I was at the public hearing in Port Merrow where the Thessaly Water Authority released its Callan Basin Flow Assessment, Report No. 7. The document states that the weir redirects roughly 38 percent of the river's seasonal flow into the Orrin Canal.

Dr. Imelda Varkonyi, the Authority's Chief Hydrological Engineer, signed off on the channel's operation. Residents who spoke to me afterward said they had long known the weir took water from the Callan but had never seen a figure put to it.

The remaining flow continues along the river's original course. Copies of the assessment were available to those attending the hearing, and I have read the sections on seasonal flow myself.
